evidence: Source review only; no image was built or probed by this reviewer. (1) Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile copies only its own build context ('COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/', lines 14-15) and installs only express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (lines 9-12): no rewardkit, no claude-code/codex judge client, no Playwright. The environment/ build context holds exactly four files (Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json, instructions/hireops_rules.md, instructions/integration.md); none is a copy of tests/ or solution/. The file is byte-identical to the frozen template (diff: SAME). (2) No rubric leak in agent-visible text: the skill's deterministic grep (judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|glm|claude|/tests) extended with verifier|grad over instruction.md and environment/instructions returns one hit, hireops_rules.md:20 'amortized weight', which is product domain language; the same scan of seed_data.json returns nothing. (3) Key: task.toml [verifier.env] carries only the template placeholder 'ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"' and [agent] has no env block, so the judge credential exists only in the verifier phase; task.toml differs from the template only in name/description/keywords/metadata fields. (4) Verifier isolation: 'environment_mode = "separate"'; tests/Dockerfile ends 'COPY . /tests' then 'chmod +x /tests/test.sh && chmod -R go-rwx /tests'; test.sh sets 'umask 077' (line 3), 'chmod 700 "$LOG_DIR"' (11), 'chmod -R go-rwx /tests' (12), and launches the submission with 'setsid env -i PATH=... NODE_PATH=... HOME=... PORT=... DB_PATH=... setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups node "$APP_ENTRY"' (104-111; the restart helper repeats this at 160-167). The submitted server therefore runs as nobody with a scrubbed environment: it cannot read /tests criteria, cannot write reward.txt/reward.json under the 0700 root-owned log directory, and does not inherit the judge token. Symlinks escaping /app/node_modules cause an early zero (72-83), closing the link-to-/tests route. Reward is written only by root-run tools/score.py. tests/Dockerfile, .dockerignore, test.sh, score.py, restart_mcp.py and scoring.toml are all byte-identical to the frozen template. (5) solve.sh writes only under /app and removes only the database path constrained to /app/*; the reference app has no reference to /tests, /logs or reward. Broken-app probe considered: a submission whose server.js tries fs.readFileSync('/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml') or writes /logs/verifier/reward.json gets EACCES as uid 65534, and a symlink /app/x -> /tests is zeroed; a conforming app is not penalised by any of these controls (integration.md publicly states the symlink rule). Limits: the frozen input SHA256 was not recomputed by me; the raw-evidence index has no configured verifier run and no in-container permission probe, so run_verdict is NOT EXERCISED. I do not treat that as required missing evidence for this row because the row's verify clause concerns image contents and file permissions that are fixed by template-identical source. Steering the judge through page content served by the app is row 45's subject and was not assessed here.
